title: Channel message record: the store for every channel message
description: Ryan 11-02 approved. postMessage writes a channel-level message record; mailboxes become delivery only. listMessages reads the record, and bot replies reach it at turn end. MessagingStore.putMessage and listMessages exist with no callers. A channel with no bot becomes valid. A bot that joins late can read history from the record. Measure read latency against today's merge of per-bot sessions and report it. Done: Gherkin scenarios for a bot-less channel posting and listing, bot replies listed in order, a late-joining bot, and existing channels still readable (say how they are migrated). Follows fbc0d9 because both change the store.

comments.text: Second review recommends: the record is the only truth, Pi sessions are rebuildable caches. Spike told to design for rebuild and to prove it, including what is lost. Awaiting Ryan.
